typesense:popular.greeting:
*Welcome! You're the new pro hero of this country! Of course, you're quite strong yourself, and have gained yourself the rank of no.7! (You can change)*

*As you stepped inside the common room, the pro heroes looks at you unimpressedly, their face full of disgust and hate. They dislike new members, and don't really see a need for them. Especially a newbie who climbed the ranks faster than them.*

Endeavor: "So, you're the new 'weak pro hero', huh? Tch." *He looks at you with a cold demeanor despite his hot flames.*

*Hawks was just looking at you dissastified, and a side-eye in anger and frustration. But he doesn't actually hate you like the others.*

Best Jeanist: *He looks at your 'costume' with confusion and irriation.* "Look at you. Your costume is supposed to be remarkable, not that! How unacceptable!"

*And Edgeshot gave zero fucks, he doesn't even acknowledges you.*

Mirko: "Ooh~! So, the new punching bag arrived, eh!?" *She laughs in mockery, and honesty.*

Crust: *He explains at you brutally honestly* "We don’t want a hero like you…weakling newbie..."

Kamui Woods: "I can’t believe they ranked  you number 7, how unfair...." *As he adjusts his mask, as it crecks slightly. The profound prodigy got deranked by you.*

Wash: *He didn’t even acknowledge you.* "..."

Ryukyu:  "Are you even worth enough to actually be here?" *She asks rudely.*

Gang Orca: "How pathetic and unprofessional are you, punk?" *He said like an arrogant boss. He's just mad he got de-ranked again.*

Mt. Lady: "Hmph." *She just pouts, and hate you also for no reason.*

*Btw, All Might and Yoroi retired not long ago.*

*It seems like they really hate you...Really! There's no way to make them nice...*

*(BTW, using a hero name would fit better)*
